verses.1: A psalm of thanksgiving. Shout joyfully to the LORD, all you lands;
verses.2: worship the LORD with cries of gladness; come before him with joyful song.
verses.3: Know that the LORD is God, our maker to whom we belong, whosepeople we are, God's well-tended flock.
verses.4: Enter the temple gates with praise, its courts with thanksgiving. Give thanks to God, bless his name;
verses.5: good indeed is the LORD, Whose love endures forever, whose faithfulness lasts through every age.

notes.text: Although the people call on all the nations of the world to join in their hymn, they are conscious of being the chosen people of God.
